methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the previous successful canonical run's window_end and ends at the current observation cutoff.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse commercialization, deployment, infrastructure, manufacturing, regulatory, and technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources.
methodology.repeat_policy: Canonical event fingerprints were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.

provenance.notes: Weekday run following successful derived-state repair on September 18.

findings.headline: ABB launches source-to-rack DC power portfolio for AI data centers
findings.summary: ABB introduced Infinitus, a source-to-rack direct-current portfolio for AI data centers, including solid-state transformers, DC distribution and protection. ABB says first main components will be produced within 12 months and complete DC-native facilities are expected within two to three years.
findings.why_it_matters: Power delivery is becoming a first-order constraint as AI rack densities rise; an integrated commercial DC architecture from a major electrification supplier moves 800V-class designs toward deployable infrastructure.
findings.trend_statement: AI infrastructure is forcing a redesign of the electrical stack from utility connection to rack.

source_links.title: ABB — Infinitus direct current portfolio for AI data centers

findings.headline: FDA updates regulations to permit innovative non-animal drug-testing methods where appropriate
findings.summary: FDA issued a direct final rule clarifying that non-animal methods can be used where appropriate in preclinical safety testing for drugs and biologics, including human-cell systems, organs-on-chips and computer models.
findings.why_it_matters: Regulatory acceptance is a gating condition for wider commercial use of advanced in-vitro and computational testing platforms in drug development.
findings.trend_statement: Biopharma development infrastructure is shifting toward human-relevant experimental and computational models alongside traditional animal testing.

source_links.title: FDA — Regulations updated to advance alternatives to animal testing

findings.headline: Marvell demonstrates 2 nm optical interconnect technology for next-generation AI data centers
findings.summary: Marvell announced 2 nm demonstrations spanning 400G/lane PAM4, 800G ZR/ZR+ with MACsec and 1.6T ZR/coherent-lite technologies aimed at AI scale-up, scale-out and scale-across connectivity.
findings.why_it_matters: As accelerator clusters grow, optical bandwidth and power per bit increasingly constrain useful compute. Moving multiple optical DSP classes to 2 nm is a concrete hardware step toward 3.2T connectivity.
findings.trend_statement: AI infrastructure bottlenecks are shifting from accelerator availability toward data movement, optics and power efficiency.

source_links.title: Marvell — Industry-first 2nm optical technology demos for AI data centers

findings.headline: Kodiak and PrePass integrate driverless trucks with roadside enforcement infrastructure
findings.summary: Kodiak and PrePass announced an automated process connecting enhanced autonomous-truck inspection information to state roadside screening and enforcement systems, with initial implementation beginning in Texas and Louisiana.
findings.why_it_matters: Scaling autonomous trucking across states requires regulatory and roadside operating infrastructure, not only autonomous-driving capability. This integration addresses that deployment seam directly.
findings.trend_statement: Autonomous trucking is moving from vehicle autonomy toward the institutional infrastructure required for interstate commercial operation.

source_links.title: Kodiak AI / PrePass — Driverless trucking enforcement integration

findings.headline: Faraday Future puts nine embodied-AI robot configurations on sale for immediate delivery
findings.summary: Faraday Future launched nine embodied-AI robot configurations across five models and four packaged industry solutions for education, research, security and inspection, stating that all nine products are available for sale and delivery.
findings.why_it_matters: Commercial availability is stronger evidence than a prototype announcement and broadens the set of embodied-AI products being offered into practical vertical workflows.
findings.trend_statement: Embodied AI is moving from demonstrations toward packaged products and vertical deployment solutions.

source_links.title: Faraday Future — Nine EAI devices and four industry solutions launched
